task.title: Navigating to a Red Hat Quay health check endpoint
task.shortdesc: To check the health of your Red Hat Quay instance and view service status, you can navigate to the health/instance endpoint in your browser. The endpoint returns JSON with status_code 200 for healthy or 503 when your deployment has an issue.

step.cmd: On your web browser, navigate to https://{quay-ip-endpoint}/health/instance.
You are taken to the health instance page, which returns information like the following:

info.p: For Red Hat Quay, "status_code": 200 means that the instance is healthy. Conversely, if you receive "status_code": 503, your deployment has an issue.
